To write the sentence in capital single stroke letters of size $20\text{ mm}$:

1. Draw faint parallel guideline boundaries spaced $20\text{ mm}$ apart.
2. Use vertical or $75^\circ$ inclined uppercase single-stroke gothic lettering.
3. Maintain a standard stroke width-to-height ratio of roughly 1:10 ($2\text{ mm}$) and a letter-to-letter spacing equal to twice the stroke width.

```text
==================== (20 mm Guideline top)
 H A R D   W O R K   I S   T H E   K E Y   T O   S U C C E S S
==================== (20 mm Guideline bottom)
```
proTip: Ensure uniform height and vertical alignment for all letters; guidelines are mandatory in examinations.
